source.title: A photoconversion model for full spectral programming and multiplexing of optogenetic systems
source.authors: Olson EJ, Tzouanas CN, Tabor JJ
source.dataset: Dataset EV2 · CcaSR measurements and analysis (MSB-13-926-s010.zip)
source.changes: Columns renamed; values rounded to the precision shown; rows sorted. No point was averaged, rescaled or removed. The spectral-validation plates (folder sv) are not included: their concise table does not name the LEDs of each well.

design.forward: Forward action spectrum (aas): one LED alone at 12 intensities for 480 min; the reporter after 480 min.
design.reverse: Reverse action spectrum (ras): the same LED and intensities on top of 1.25 µmol m⁻² s⁻¹ of green light (520-2-KB).
design.control: Rows with led 'None' carry no spectral LED: dark wells in the forward plates, green-only wells in the reverse plates.

publishedModel.name: Olson et al. 2017, CcaSR model rgv2_m01
equations: dy/dt = k1(I)·(1 − y) − (k2(I) + kdr + kg)·y,  k1(I) = Σ k1_led·I_led,  k2(I) = Σ k2_led·I_led
P(t) = b + a·rⁿ/(kⁿ + rⁿ),  r = y/(1 − y)
publishedModel.note: Parameters as distributed with the dataset (all_data_with_k2_holds_ratio_onetau_k_fixed). The published fit used the action spectra and every step-on and step-off plate; the dynamic programs were its validation.
